title: At the Doctor's Office
summaryZh: 病人向醫生描述喉嚨痛和發燒的情況，醫生檢查後給了休息建議。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Good morning, Mr. Chen. So what brings you in today?
sentences.zh: 陳先生早安。今天是哪裡不舒服呢？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: My throat has hurt since Monday, and I had a fever.
sentences.zh: 我從星期一開始喉嚨就很痛，而且有發燒。
sentences.note: had a → /hæɾə/，d 夾在母音之間變成閃音。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: How high did the fever get? Did you check it?
sentences.note: Did you → /dɪdʒə/，兩字合併成 /dʒ/ 音。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: It was thirty eight last night, but it dropped this morning.
sentences.zh: 昨天晚上三十八度，不過今天早上退了。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Okay. Have you had any trouble breathing or swallowing food?
sentences.zh: 好。那你呼吸或吞東西有困難嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Swallowing hurts a lot, but breathing has been totally fine.
sentences.zh: 吞東西很痛，但呼吸完全沒問題。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Let me take a look. Open wide and say ah.
sentences.zh: 我看一下。嘴巴張大，說「啊」。
sentences.note: take a look → /teɪkəlʊk/，三字連成一串，a 弱讀成 /ə/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Your throat is quite red, but I don't see any spots.
sentences.zh: 你的喉嚨滿紅的，不過我沒看到白點。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Is it serious? I have to fly to Japan on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 嚴重嗎？我星期六要飛日本。
sentences.note: have to → /hæftə/，v 變成 /f/ 音，to 弱讀成 /tə/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: It looks like a normal virus, so you should be fine.
sentences.zh: 看起來是一般的病毒感染，你應該沒問題。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Drink lots of water and rest as much as you can.
sentences.note: lots of → /lɑtsəv/，of 弱讀；water 的 t 是閃音 /ˈwɔɾɚ/。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Should I take medicine, or will it just go away?
sentences.zh: 我需要吃藥嗎？還是它自己會好？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Take something for the pain, and it should clear up soon.
sentences.zh: 可以吃點止痛的，應該很快就會好。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: If the fever comes back on Friday, please call me first.
sentences.zh: 如果星期五又發燒，請先打電話給我。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I will, thank you doctor. I already feel a little better.
sentences.zh: 我會的，謝謝醫生。我已經覺得好一點了。
sentences.note: better 的 tt 是閃音 /ˈbɛɾɚ/，聽起來像 bedder。

questions.q: When did his sore throat start?
What does the doctor think the problem is?
What should he do if the fever comes back on Friday?
options: Go to the hospital right away
